news.headline: CFTC proposes federal registration framework for leveraged retail crypto trades
news.summary: Investing.com -- The Commodity Futures Trading Commission unveiled an Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking on Monday aimed at establishing a tailored regulatory framework for leveraged digital asset transactions offered to retail investors. The initiative draws on the agency’s existing authority under section 2(c)(2)(D) of the Commodity Exchange Act to integrate crypto trading into its national market structure, opening a 60-day public comment window to shape future formal rules.
